acid-catalyst-cartridge.name: 硫酸催化剂定量包
acid-catalyst-cartridge.classification: 化合物；GT 流体的含水量与纯度未编码
acid-catalyst-cartridge.classificationEn: Compound; the GT fluid does not encode water content or purity
acid-catalyst-cartridge.role: 乙酸乙酯酯化催化额度；与硫酸反应物包分别计量，不能互换
acid-catalyst-cartridge.roleEn: Esterification catalyst allowance; kept separate from the sulfuric-acid reagent dose
acid-catalyst-cartridge.preparation: 现实供应链：含硫原料 → SO2 → 催化氧化 SO3 → 吸收与浓度调整。游戏内 sulfuricacid 原生路线以当前 NEI 为准。
acid-catalyst-cartridge.preparationEn: Real supply: sulfur feed → SO2 → catalytic SO3 formation → absorption and concentration control. Consult current NEI for native sulfuricacid recipes.

dryer-cartridge.name: 沸石干燥介质包
dryer-cartridge.classification: 铝硅酸盐骨架材料；组成、交换阳离子和含水量可变
dryer-cartridge.classificationEn: Aluminosilicate framework material with variable composition, cations and hydration
dryer-cartridge.role: 有限吸水能力；不等同于已活化 3A 分子筛；用后独立收集
dryer-cartridge.roleEn: Finite drying allowance; not certified activated 3A molecular sieve; collect spent medium separately
dryer-cartridge.preparation: 现实可采用沸石矿物加工或铝硅酸盐水热合成，再进行离子交换、成型和活化。再生须收集脱附水；本版使用 GT 沸石粉封装。
dryer-cartridge.preparationEn: Real supply uses mineral processing or hydrothermal aluminosilicate synthesis, then ion exchange, forming and activation. Regeneration needs a desorbed-water outlet. This release packages GT zeolite dust.

heater-charge.name: 煤粉燃料定量包
heater-charge.classification: 多组分固体燃料；不是纯碳，也不是热量物质
heater-charge.classificationEn: Multicomponent solid fuel, neither pure carbon nor a substance called heat
heater-charge.role: 游戏供热成本；不作为反应试剂，也不由此推算燃烧热
heater-charge.roleEn: Game heating cost, not a reagent or a calibrated combustion enthalpy
heater-charge.preparation: 游戏先取得煤并按 NEI 粉碎成煤粉。后续锅炉公用工程应拆出燃料、空气、烟气、灰渣与蒸汽供回管。
heater-charge.preparationEn: Obtain coal and use NEI to grind it to dust. A boiler utility expansion needs fuel, air, flue gas, ash, steam supply and return.

treatment-service-cartridge.name: 委外处置凭证
treatment-service-cartridge.classification: 非物质服务凭证；不是化合物、单质或混合物
treatment-service-cartridge.classificationEn: Non-material service credit; not a compound, element or mixture
treatment-service-cartridge.recipe: 1000 mB water + 1 dustCoal + 1 dustIron → 1 凭证；电路 24
treatment-service-cartridge.recipeEn: 1000 mB water + 1 dustCoal + 1 dustIron → 1 voucher; circuit 24
treatment-service-cartridge.role: 每批后处理扣 1 张；支付委外服务，残余组成与去向仍留账
treatment-service-cartridge.roleEn: One voucher per batch workup; pays disposal while composition and destination remain recorded
treatment-service-cartridge.preparation: 由 OC 在 GT 大型化学反应釜中注册的游戏成本配方；不是水、煤和铁发生了真实合成。单独存放在凭证仓，专用供料通道代表凭证交接。
treatment-service-cartridge.preparationEn: An OC game-cost recipe registered in the GT Large Chemical Reactor, not a real synthesis of water, coal and iron. Its separate store and channel represent voucher custody.
